procedural_matters: A panel of the international jury was constituted as per RRS N1.4(b).
GRN 26 did not come to the hearing.
The hearing proceeded as permitted by RRS 63.1(b)
facts: GER 3 showered, dried and changed clothes for about 45 minutes.
Damage was a 10cm gelcoat crack on the port gunwale.
GER 3 sailed and completed all races on the day.
conclusions: There was no good reason to extend the protest time limit per RRS 60.3(b)
